Job Summary

Supervise maintenance planning activities on site/in the field incl. plan, coordinate, schedule, and monitor all maintenance planning activities in > 1-3 months horizon pertaining to asset project (heavy equipment) in order to ensure all maintenance activities in project are effective and efficient in timely manner conform to the project schedule and budget.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Supervise and support team and peers by ensuring that all routine maintenance activities for the machines or equipment are appropriately planned (resources, parts, tooling) and scheduled (with Production and Maintenance) so that the work progresses in a safe and efficient manner.
All routine maintenance activities for the machines or equipment are appropriately planned (resources, parts, tooling) and scheduled which led to efficient work progress.

Optimizing the performance of people by having regular coach, mentor process to develop people within planning functionality
The performance is successfully optimized.

Supports team and peers to ensure on time Distributes weekly and bi-weekly scheduled work to the operations and maintenance supervisors and all appropriate standard job plans/packages included, activities are prioritized, managed effectively and are executed to specification on time.
All appropriate standard job plans/packages included, activities are prioritized, managed effectively, and are executed to specification on time.

Provide formal analysis and the derived conclusion on asset performance in relation with actual maintenance plan. It includes ad- hoc or specific analysis requirement e.g. in order to find out the effectiveness of newly implemented improvement program.
Analysis and conclusions are successfully provided and has a significant impact in program improvements.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Bachelor's Degree of Engineering

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 2-3 year experiences particularly in Heavy/Mobile maintenance strategy.
• Qualifications and certificates in field of trade/required duties
• Conducts mechanical work to PTP and OEM maintenance standars to help achieve high mechanical availability
• Broad knowledge of heavy equipment maintenance
• Good understanding of mechanical availability and correct repair and maintenance methods
• Good understanding of mining requirements and production targets
• Fluent in English, both
spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 6.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

wo-klbf-JR26_001843.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Shipping and Receiving Document Management:
() Manage and process shipping and receiving documents, ensuring all paperwork is accurate and properly filed.
- Data Recording and Maintenance:
() Record and maintain accurate data of logistics transactions in the system.
() Ensure up-to-date inventory records and assist in data management.
- Coordination with the Warehouse Team:
() Coordinate with the warehouse team to ensure goods are received and shipped according to schedule.
() Manage and distribute logistics-related documents to the warehouse team and drivers.
- Report Preparation:
() Assist in the preparation of reports related to logistics activities, such as shipment reports, goods received, and stock movements.
() Monitor the status of shipments and report any delays or operational issues.
- Communication with Suppliers and Customers:
() Communicate with suppliers and customers regarding shipping documents, shipment status, and ensure that goods are received as ordered.
- Logistics System Management:
() Enter and update data in logistics management systems or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software.
() Ensure the information in the system is accurate and complies with company procedures.

- Manajemen Dokumen Pengiriman dan Penerimaan:
() Mengelola dan memproses dokumen pengiriman dan penerimaan, memastikan semua dokumen akurat dan tersimpan dengan baik.
- Pencatatan dan Pemeliharaan Data:
() Mencatat dan memelihara data transaksi logistik yang akurat dalam sistem.
() Memastikan catatan inventaris selalu terbaru dan membantu dalam manajemen data.
- Koordinasi dengan Tim Gudang:
() Berkoordinasi dengan tim gudang untuk memastikan barang diterima dan dikirim sesuai jadwal.
() Mengelola dan mendistribusikan dokumen terkait logistik kepada tim gudang dan pengemudi.
- Persiapan Laporan:
() Membantu dalam persiapan laporan terkait aktivitas logistik, seperti laporan pengiriman, barang yang diterima, dan pergerakan stok.
() Memantau status pengiriman dan melaporkan setiap keterlambatan atau masalah operasional.
- Komunikasi dengan Pemasok dan Pelanggan:
() Berkomunikasi dengan pemasok dan pelanggan mengenai dokumen pengiriman, status pengiriman, dan memastikan barang diterima sesuai pesanan.
- Manajemen Sistem Logistik:
() Memasukkan dan memperbarui data dalam sistem manajemen logistik atau perangkat lunak Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP).
() Memastikan informasi dalam sistem akurat dan sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan.

Company:
DF PT. Dankos Farma
